shims.name: authorization_endpoint added to OAuth authorization server metadata
shims.reason: Inji Certify advertises grant type authorization_code without authorization_endpoint (RFC 8414 section 2). The suite aborts all issuance modules at setup, hiding every other result.

shims.name: credential issuer metadata served at the path-inserted well-known URL
shims.reason: OID4VCI 1.0 section 12.2.2 metadata location for issuers with a path component.

plans.description: OID4VCI 1.0 Final, SD-JWT VC, issuer-initiated pre-authorized code flow using Inji Certify's built-in authorization server (no eSignet dependency).

readiness.description: The certifiable OID4VCI HAIP profile: authorization code flow with PAR, DPoP sender-constrained tokens and OAuth client attestation.

requires.name: DPoP proofs validated and enforced on token and credential endpoints
requires.note: 1.0.0-alpha.1 accepts the DPoP-variant flow; DPoP proof validation (DpopProofValidator) landed on develop afterwards.

requires.name: client_auth_type=client_attestation (OAuth attestation-based client auth)
requires.note: Not implemented in Inji Certify or eSignet as of 1.0.0-alpha.1.

requires.name: authorization_code grant with PAR against the configured AS
requires.note: Depends on eSignet; PAR client assertion currently fails in the suite.

requires.name: Credential issuer metadata at the path-inserted well-known URL
requires.note: The harness gateway serves a compatibility route; the product fix is tracked upstream.

requires.name: Nonce endpoint and jwt proof type (OID4VCI 1.0 Final)
